## What it is

The open, U-shaped footprint for the standalone recording tower. Print one.

## Design notes

The 230 mm rearward feet fit the 250 mm Kobra S1 bed and counterbalance the phone's forward reach without occupying either writing edge. The open middle saves material. Two 18 mm-deep bosses receive the full mast sections. Their revised 24.2 x 18.2 mm openings leave 0.2 mm total clearance around the 24 x 18 mm mast. Two integral 5.2 mm dowels in each socket engage 12 mm into the mast's existing bottom pin sockets, matching the proven pin fit.

Eight sub-1 mm² faces are the expected corner triangles from the 1 mm polish chamfers on the two socket bosses.

## Don't

Do not remove the internal dowels: the outer socket alone still permits perceptible movement. Do not restore the original 24.4 x 18.4 mm sockets; the printed fit wobbled. Do not extend feet beside the tablet; that would obstruct the writer's forearms and make the design handed. Do not narrow the footprint until a physical tip test has been performed with the heaviest target phone.
